items.distractor_fact: Duka jingine liliweka akiba ya euro {D} kwenye akaunti yake tofauti wiki hiyo hiyo.
items.gloss_en: A different shop deposited savings of {D} euros into its own separate account that same week.
items.entity_note: a shop's own deposit (an organisation), not a fellow trader (a person) as in the first distractor, and not the trader/account whose balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Mchezaji mmoja kutoka klabu nyingine alifunga mabao {D} msimu huo.
items.gloss_en: A player from a different club scored {D} goals that same season.
items.entity_note: one player's own tally (a person), not another team in the league (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the team whose scored/conceded goals are compared

items.distractor_fact: Kampuni jirani ya uwekezaji iliripoti faida ya dola {D} msimu uliopita.
items.gloss_en: A neighbouring investment company reported a gain of {D} dollars last season.
items.entity_note: a company's own report (an organisation), not a fellow investor (a person) as in the first distractor, and not this investor's gain/loss for this year

items.distractor_fact: Katika mashindano mengine yaliyofanyika siku hiyo hiyo, mshiriki mmoja alipata mapigo {D} kwenye uwanja wenye par yake mwenyewe.
items.gloss_en: In a different tournament held that same day, one competitor scored {D} strokes on a course with its own separate par.
items.entity_note: a separate tournament's own round (a series/event), not another player (a person) as in the first distractor, and the course's par there is its own, not the stated par S

items.distractor_fact: Uwanja mwingine katika jiji hilo ulirekodi mabao {D} katika mechi nyingine wikendi hiyo.
items.gloss_en: A different stadium in that city recorded {D} goals in a different match that same weekend.
items.entity_note: a stadium's own record (a place), not Timu C (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not Timu A or Timu B whose goals are compared

items.distractor_fact: Chuo kingine kilirekodi wastani wa alama {D} kwenye mtihani wake wenyewe wiki hiyo.
items.gloss_en: A different school recorded an average of {D} marks on its own exam that same week.
items.entity_note: a school's own record (an organisation), not another student (a person) as in the first distractor, and not Neema or Zawadi whose marks are compared
